verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents browser sessions, a web search API that finds relevant websites from a query, and a fetch API that converts a single URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. None of these is a site-mapping or URL-discovery capability that lists all URLs on a website without crawling. Search and fetch are adjacent features and earn no credit, and URL discovery is a fair axis for a web-data and browser platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
